issue.title: Login timeout
issue.description: Login requests time out after a gateway restart. The cause is unknown.

issue.title: Alert delay
issue.description: Alert A-17 arrives late after a synthetic queue pause. No cause has been confirmed.

issue.title: Search errors
issue.description: Search returns errors for two invented queries. The cause is under investigation.

issue.title: Duplicate notice
issue.description: Two synthetic notices were emitted for the same event. The cause is unknown.

issue.title: Missing dashboard tile
issue.description: The dashboard tile is absent for an invented tenant. No change has been approved.

issue.title: Slow report
issue.description: A synthetic report takes longer than the expected five seconds. The cause is unknown.

issue.title: Stale page
issue.description: A status page shows an older synthetic update. No cache cause is verified.

issue.title: Upload retry
issue.description: An invented upload was retried twice. The effect on stored records is not yet checked.

issue.title: Access denial
issue.description: A synthetic user received a 403 response. The permission cause is not confirmed.

issue.title: Webhook gap
issue.description: A synthetic webhook event is absent from the receiver log. Delivery state is unknown.
